# Aspen II Homes (aspen2homes.com)

> Aspen II Homes, Inc. (CSLB #1004058) is a premier local new home builder constructing semi-custom, single-family residential homes in Tehachapi and eastern Kern County, California since 1994.

## Core Facts & Business Credentials
- **Legal Entity:** Aspen II Homes, Inc. (CSLB #1004058, Class B - General Building Contractor)
- **Founding:** Building in Tehachapi since 1994 (incorporated as Aspen II Homes, Inc. in 2015)
- **Headquarters:** 785 Tucker Road G295, Tehachapi, CA 93561
- **Phone:** (661) 241-0306
- **Email:** Aspen2homes@gmail.com
- **Hours:** Open daily, 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM
- **Ratings & Credentials:** BBB A+ Accredited, BuildZoom Top 2% California Contractor, Equal Housing Opportunity Builder.

## Featured Community: Sunset Retreat (Tehachapi, CA)
- **Base Pricing:** Starting from $459,000
- **Model:** Sunset Retreat Model (1,715 sq ft, 3 Bed, 2 Bath, 2-Car Garage)
- **Current Phase:** Phase 1 now reserving with ~3 months to move-in
- **Promotional Incentive:** Up to $15,000 early-buyer personalization/buydown credit for early phase reservations
- **Financing:** 0% down financing programs available for eligible first-time buyers, FHA low-down, VA military zero-down, and conventional lending options.

6. **Tranquil Oasis:** 1,938 sq ft | 3 Bed | 2 Bath | Single-Story | Flow-through entertainer layout with chef's kitchen island

## Mountain Climate Construction Standards
- Built specifically for Tehachapi mountain elevation (~4,000 ft)
- Engineered for heavy snow loads (engineered roof trusses) and mountain wind ratings
- Advanced Title 24 energy efficiency: radiant barrier roof decking, high-R blown-in insulation, and dual-pane Low-E argon-filled windows
- Solar-ready electrical infrastructure and fire-resistant defensible construction.

## Service Areas (Eastern Kern County)
- Tehachapi, CA (Downtown, Old Town, Country Club, Oak Knolls)
- Stallion Springs, CA
- Bear Valley Springs, CA
- Golden Hills, CA
- Alpine Forest, CA
- Mojave & Rosamond, CA
